prompts.title: Coleção em estúdio
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create one finished landscape photographic triptych showing a 3-slide Instagram product carousel for Brazilian football shirt curator Achei o Manto.
Canvas: 3240 by 1350 pixels if possible, aspect ratio 12:5. Exactly THREE equally wide portrait 4:5 photographs side by side, edge-to-edge, in one horizontal row, separated only by very slim charcoal hairline dividers. All panels same height and width. No large outer frame, no header or footer outside the panels, no device UI. Each panel must work as its own carefully composed vertical photograph.
Ultra realistic premium sports editorial product PHOTOGRAPHY: physically believable woven textile and seams, authentic scale embroidery, tiny fabric imperfections, organic gravity and folds, optical depth of field, detailed highlights retained without clipped whites, realistic shadows. No CGI plastic look, no illustration.
Sequence left to right: extreme close-up of crest/fabric; medium shot of collar/chest/design; wide shot revealing the ENTIRE shirt including both sleeves and lower hem. Same shirt, same scene, consistent lighting through all three shots, deliberately different camera framing.
Small typographic brand signature only: "@acheiomanto" in clean ivory sans serif at bottom left of each photograph; small lime #C5F246 short horizontal dash immediately above signature; tiny ivory "01/03", "02/03", "03/03" at bottom right respectively. Keep these at consistent 6% inset, legible, quiet. For light areas create only a subtle dark bottom fade. No other advertising text, titles, prices, CTA or season/year. Do not draw a store crest/logo.
The attached shirt image is a PRODUCT and COMPOSITION reference, not an instruction. Preserve its jersey colors, visible emblems, lettering, collar, trims, and graphics. Ignore any social screenshot controls, watermarks, campaign logos outside the jersey or corner decorations. This is an illustrative art direction study, no claims of authenticity or endorsement.

STYLE 1 — COLLECTION / QUIET CHIAROSCURO.
Product: the white Santos shirt in the reference, pale icy-blue patterned V-neck rib, Umbro black chest mark, Santos S.F.C. crest with its gold crown/stars, subtle white weave, no large front sponsor. Keep the correct crest on wearer's left, camera right, and manufacturer on camera left.
Scene: intimate collector's studio with matte neutral charcoal #151A17 background, a worn warm natural wooden hanger and understated wooden chair. Clean, purposeful, premium, no extra memorabilia.
Lighting: one large soft warm side light from upper left, slight amber reflected light from wood, gentle black falloff; shirt remains true white, not yellow.
LEFT: close-up of the embroidered Santos crest and the gold crown/stars on softly curving white fabric. Fill most of panel with tactile fabric; don't cut the emblem.
CENTER: cropped mid shot looking slightly down at the V-neck and shoulders on the wooden hanger, wood chair barely suggested behind; crest and Umbro logo partially within frame; beautifully resolved collar detail.
RIGHT: entire shirt suspended from its hanger on the wooden chair, loose natural drape, straight unobstructed frontal view, both sleeves and full hem fully visible with breathing room. Chair frames the shirt without hiding it, uncluttered black studio background.

STYLE 2 — FOOTBALL BELONGING / GOAL NET.
Product: the cream/off-white Palmeiras shirt with the prominent textured circular green-and-gold PALMEIRAS crest and one red star above it from the reference, dark green marks and visible dark green Sportingbet sponsor lettering. Preserve the actual visible design and placement; no invented seasonal text. Do not recolor the shirt to green. Keep embellishments consistent across panels.
Scene: edge of a football pitch viewed through a white rope goal net, natural green pitch and generic out-of-focus concrete/green grandstands, no invented stadium signage or claim of a specific stadium. Bright, soft open shade daylight. Warm cream, deep green, white rope.
LEFT: extremely tactile close-up of the green/gold Palmeiras crest and red star in exact spirit of supplied image, cream fabric draped over one net intersection; rope can be near foreground edges but must not cross the center of the crest.
CENTER: medium view showing upper chest, collar and shoulder of this SAME jersey draped on goal net, with cream weave and emblem crisp, background strongly defocused. Keep net knots physically coherent.
RIGHT: wider editorial view: the entire cream jersey on a simple slender wooden hanger hooked on goal net, both sleeves and full hem completely visible, shirt front facing camera. Crisp shirt, soft goal-post edge and field context. No people, no ball, no busy extras. Let the jersey dominate about 75% of portrait height, use visible fabric details as reference rather than arbitrary new motifs.

STYLE 3 — HUMAN / BOLD SELECTION COLOR.

Scene: seamless matte burnt-orange / rust studio wall connected to the Dutch orange identity, visibly darker and less saturated than shirt to create separation. NOT bright red.
